scope: Proposition 9.1 (Two systems on one nearby model) of the manuscript “Projective-space bases of Lagrangian fibrations” (preprints/Projective-Space-Bases-of-Lagrangian-Fibrations-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 041 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5fdf543649f1469a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 71. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Arbitrarily close to the original point of D, there is a member X′ = Xt and an integral (1, 1)-class u such that e and u are nef and q(e) = q(u) = 0, q(e, u) > 0, and the whole positive interval satisfies {ae + bu : a, b > 0} ⊂ KX′ . (9.1) In particular X′ is projective. Its fixed-base fibration f′ = ft : X′ → B admits a second projective Lagrangian fibration g : X′ → C, with C normal and projective. For every fiber A over the smooth locus of g, the restriction f′|A : A → B is finite and surjective. Thus B has a finite cover by an abelian variety.
